title: DICEBITS
description:
A falling-block puzzle game with dice. Pairs of dice drop into a 7×7 grid, and touching dice of the same value disappear once the group is at least as large as the number they show: two 2s, three 3s, four 4s and so on. A 1 never matches on its own, but when a 1 touches a group being cleared, every 1 on the grid goes with it. A full straight from 1 to 6 in a row or column clears for a bonus, and dice falling into new groups set off chains worth more with each wave.

The pace rises over 20 levels, and new elements appear along the way: random dice that change face as they fall, bricks that only special dice can remove, seekers that clear every die of one value, bombs, crosses that clear a row and column, and, from level 7, junk drops from the top of the grid. The game ends when a die is left in the top row.

This is the free demo of the full game.

Controls: Left and Right move the pair, Down soft-drops and Up hard-drops. A and B rotate, L and R hold or swap the pair, Select shows the grid lines and Start pauses. L+R+Select puts the game to sleep, and A+B+Start+Select resets it.
